sdbs.title: Smart Dynamic Bus System
sdbs.subtitle: Flutter · Firebase · Python · YOLOv8 · OpenCV
sdbs.description: A transit management project connecting passengers, drivers and administrators. A 3-role Flutter app (Passenger, Driver, Admin) on a real-time Firestore backend makes STOP / SKIP / EARLY-DEPART decisions using a capacity-aware algorithm. A Python edge-AI pipeline running YOLOv8n on Raspberry Pi counts passengers in real time; an SQLite retry queue handles cellular dropouts.
sdbs.demoNote: Browser simulation of passenger detection and route decisions. The YOLOv8n model runs in the original Python project.
highlights: Real-time Firestore sync across 3 user roles
Decision engine: STOP / SKIP / EARLY-DEPART algorithm
YOLOv8n edge pipeline with offline SQLite queue
Immutable stopDecisions audit trail in Firestore
Digital transit wallet with append-only ledger

phish.title: Phish Checker
phish.subtitle: Python · Docker · Linux (WSL)
phish.description: A CLI tool that analyses URLs and assigns an explainable phishing-risk score (0–100) from heuristics. Dockerized for consistent cross-platform execution. The live demo below is a browser port of the same heuristics: pure string analysis, no network requests.
phish.demoNote: Client-Side TypeScript Port of the Python CLI heuristics. Enter any URL. Zero network requests are made.
